config.label: Entra tenant id
config.description: Entra tenant id. Only needed for unattended app-only sign-in; omit it to sign in interactively with a device code.

config.label: Application (client) id
config.description: Application (client) id. Defaults to the public Microsoft Graph PowerShell client, so it is optional for trying the server out.

config.label: Client secret for app-only authentication
config.description: Client secret for app-only authentication. Leave unset to sign in interactively instead.

config.label: SharePoint root URL, e
config.description: SharePoint root URL, e.g. https://contoso.sharepoint.com. Required only by the SharePoint/PnP tool when PowerShell runs locally.
